title: Render thread CPU bottleneck (visibility / mesh draw calls)
fix_rationale: The trace shows the RenderThread was the bottleneck. High render thread time is commonly caused by high visible primitive counts, excessive dynamic mesh draw elements, or unbatched draw calls.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms on the RenderThread ({share}% of excess time) performing visibility culling and mesh draw generation.

fixes.text: Merge static meshes or convert repeated static actors to Hierarchical Instanced Static Meshes (HISM).
Set up Cull Distance Volumes and adjust LOD draw distances for dense foliage and props.
Reduce the number of active shadow-casting movable lights affecting the scene.

verify: Re-capture the trace and verify that visible primitive counts and RenderThread execution times decrease.
